name: pjokk
// workspaces: apps/server is deliberately absent: the backend is a Go module (apps/server/go.mod) with no package.json, so the glob that used to be apps/* is spelled out. Adding a JavaScript workspace means adding it here.
// backend: The server has no bun script. It is Go: `cd apps/server && go run ./cmd/pjokk` for the default mode, `... ./cmd/pjokk migrate` / `cron <nightly|frequent>` / `server` / `worker` for the others; `go test -p 1 ./...` for its suite. In the image the same binary is /app/pjokk. The scripts below cover the SPA, the landing site and the OpenAPI-derived client only.

scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:landing
scripts.check: biome check . && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && bun test scripts
scripts.// gen:client: openapi-typescript pins typescript@^5.x as a direct dependency, but bun hoists a single shared typescript version in node_modules and the root pins ^7.0.2 for the app itself — so a plain local-bin invocation resolves to TS 7 and crashes (ts.factory is undefined under the new API). bunx --package isolates its own dependency resolution outside the workspace tree, so it gets its own real TS 5.9.3 and runs clean; verified byte-identical output against the committed api-schema.d.ts (see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-go-migration-verification.md).
